mode: read-only source investigation; no product edits, builds or timing
conclusion: The current CPU fast kernel already computes matrix-free FWHT. Its public expression is still MUL_MAT(matrix,input)+hint, so dropping the matrix payload is not a valid current API use. Keep the current constant pending a native unary/bridge API that explicitly owns no matrix storage. No GPU Kronecker scheme or logW operator graph is proposed for this batch.

current_hyle.note: One cold immutable F32 Sylvester matrix per Hadamard node; W*W overflow checks, resize(W*W), +/-1/sqrt(W) generation. W4096 is 67,108,864 bytes (64 MiB) per node; W8192 is 256 MiB. This is a cold host constant, not a measured hot-path performance loss.
Creates a real W-by-W F32 tensor backed by the program matrix, MUL_MAT(as_float(input)), Hadamard hint and F32 accumulation. as_output performs the final public dtype conversion.
Provider accepts one dense floating input and F32 accumulation. F16/BF16 inputs widen via as_float, so this path reaches native FWHT with F32 input.
Public schema requires floating rank>=1 and positive power-of-two last dimension; output keeps input dtype.
Uses selected CpuProgram graph plan/compute and does not enable use_ref.
Selected baseline or isolated AVX2 complete CPU program. A private direct kernel call must not accidentally bypass this ISA selection/ABI.
Invocation manual allocator skips the real constant because its data is non-null; dropping data would instead request native W*W nbytes.

kernel_and_support.note: FWHT implementation reads src0 only through tensor metadata locals; there is no src0->data read. Reads src1 rows, computes scale=1/sqrtf(n), writes F32 destination and performs scalar/SIMD butterflies. Supports all positive power-of-two widths; no 64..512 GPU-style width limit.
Native input dispatch is F32 or F16 only; destination F32. Hyle widens BF16 before this point.
Hint and !use_ref enter FWHT and return before tiled/ordinary GEMM. This is the current actual Hyle path.
Backend supports-op recognizes hinted F32 src0/F32 dst with F32 or F16 src1. No public unary FWHT is declared.
BLAS backend explicitly declines the Hadamard hint so CPU FWHT remains owner.
Current CPU graph fusion handles RMSNorm+Mul, not a Hadamard+quantization or other matrix-reading fusion.
Tiled helper accepts quantized src0 types, excludes F32 Hadamard matrix. No extra W-squared tiled workspace is inferred for this path.
Repacked weight kernels require a special repack buffer. Current Hyle constant is a raw program-owned F32 pointer with no such buffer; no repack/quantization transforms it.

why_not_dummy_storage.note: ggml_mul_mat constructs its result from a.ne[1], b dimensions and stores both source tensors. The hint setter changes op_params only, not source storage semantics.
ggml_nbytes computes actual tensor span from dimensions/strides; a normal contiguous W-by-W F32 tensor requires 4W^2 bytes.
With use_ref=true the FWHT early-return is disabled. The ordinary matmul path then reads src0 rows (e.g. 1313/1395) and all W-by-W values are required.
The native backend exposes ggml_backend_cpu_set_use_ref. Although Hyle does not enable it now, the matrix remains part of the native operation contract.

api_options.finding: No unary Hadamard/FWHT entry found in pinned include/ggml.h or ggml-cpu.h. The only named Hadamard facility is GGML_HINT_SRC0_IS_HADAMARD on MUL_MAT.

reference.note: map_custom1/custom_4d can express a unary node but require a callback implementation.

api_options.finding: They are not an existing callable public FWHT kernel API. ggml_compute_forward_fwht is private ops.h and consumes private ggml_compute_params. Calling it from a new Hyle callback would depend on internal ABI and selected CPU program/ISA; do not treat this as a drop-in public-API fix.

Add/Sub/Concat can mathematically express logW stages without W^2 constants or a new numerical kernel, but creates multiple operators/barriers and with the current manual allocator retains stage payloads. No timing/precision/allocator validation was performed. Explicitly rejected for this batch rather than risk an unproven hot-path tradeoff.

Add a native unary Hadamard constructor or a private same-revision CPU bridge that accepts only the actual input/output and delegates to the existing FWHT body; preserve its F32 accumulation/scaling and expose no fake matrix. Route through the selected baseline/AVX2 program. This is a native API/bridge extension, not a new numerical kernel. It needs affected adapter/dispatch objects and relink; exact minimal build closure has not been implemented or verified.

status: Pending native unary/bridge support. Current 64 MiB W4096 cold constant remains. No current throughput loss is claimed and no tests/benchmarks were run.
